hypothesis: WebMCP-first compiled bypass (O(1) amortized IR) will break the 21/40=0.525 ceiling where retrieval-only methods stall: pooled correct-family >=0.60 with gain >=0.10 over best flat RAG under honest cost, header >=4/10 and mixed >=4/10, ECE<=0.15, false_accept<=0.15, and O(1) $0.002-0.092 at f=10 vs O(MxN) browser steps, with compilation IR manifest proving TreeWalker compression+ranks and tool contracts (policy risk/semantic precedence/shadow-DOM). Endpoint-catalog is predicted to improve over hierarchical/flat but is expected to be non-inferior or slightly below compiled on mixed triple-channel joint composition (requires Fetch/OpenAPI normalization if still 0/10). Flat TFIDF-K5 remains bounded ~0.525, hierarchical ~0.525-0.55, endpoint-catalog moderately above (0.55-0.60) but compiled achieves the step-change if tool declarations are cooperative and verifiable.
falsifier: MEASUREMENT_INVALID if any PC fails (PC-EXACT-MATCH, PC-RETRIEVAL-HEALTH, PC-WEBAPI-INDEX-BUILT, PC-COMPILED-IR-BUILT, PC-HONEST-COST-SANITY, PC-BROWSERGYM-HEALTH-gating, PC-FRESHNESS-NONCIRCULAR, PC-AX-CDP, PC-CONFIDENCE-DERIVED) or any NC fails (NC-NO-APPLICABLE, NC-EMPTY, NC-ORACLE-LEAK, NC-STAGEHAND-ISOLATION) or arm code-identity (hierarchical==webapi or compiled delegates to hierarchical) or honest_cost != sum counters+browser_steps (jitter/f*6.0) or |rho_shuffled|>=0.20 permutation p<0.20 or within-f std==0 or n*3200 bijective. SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST requires controls pass and at least one of compiled or endpoint-catalog passes S1-S7 (section decision_rule). baselines: B-EXACT-MATCH-CF (ID B-EXACT-MATCH): SpiderKernel.resolve exact intent equality L97, min_confidence 0.8, candidates sorted by confidence, correct-family gating, no retrieval diversity. Expected pooled alias-OOD 0/40 under CF, calibrates regression.

B-FLAT-TFIDF-K5-CF (ID B-FLAT-TFIDF-K5-CF): Flat TF-IDF retriever over mechanism intent+template strings (fit train registry only), cosine top-k=5, correct-family-required rewriting (adopt only if candidate family overlaps derived_context family, cross-family forbidden), softmax temp 0.15 + deterministic jitter gated UNKNOWN<0.80, verify+freshness gates. Strong flat baseline for primary McNemar.

B-FLAT-EMBED-K5-CF (ID B-FLAT-EMBED-K5-CF): Same as TFIDF but sentence-transformer all-MiniLM-L6-v2 normalized cosine (offline, deterministic). If model unavailable, mark unavailable with disclosure and TFIDF becomes best flat. Never uses hidden_expected signals.

H-HIERARCHICAL-CF (ID H-HIERARCHICAL-CF): xMemory hierarchical decoupling episode->semantic component->theme (Level1 episodes=mechanisms, Level2 components via regex ${slot} parsing, Level3 themes via Jaccard>=0.6 agglomerative, theme centroids TFIDF, top-down complementary selection entropy>0.4 or distinct coverage<2, adaptive k 3-5) with correct-family gating, softmax temp 0.15+jitter UNKNOWN<0.80, verify+freshness gates. Genuine hierarchical implementation must differ from webapi index.

H-WEBAPI-ENDPOINT-CF (ID H-WEBAPI-CF): Genuine endpoint-catalog clustering distinct from hierarchical: endpoint specs (method+path_template+header_template+body_template+auth_scope) parsed via regex ${slot} into component sets {path_segments, query_keys, header_keys, body_fields, auth_scopes, method}, Level3 endpoint themes via Jaccard>=0.6 on endpoint component sets, centroids on endpoint component lexical space, complementary selection same criteria adaptive k 3-5, endpoint invocation via correct-family endpoint adoption (method/path/header/body/auth_scope) before _bind+verify. All indexing fit train registry only. Must prove non-identity to hierarchical via retrieved_id/theme overlap <0.90 and manifest hash distinct.

B-COMPILED-WEBMCP-CF (ID B-COMPILED-CF): WebMCP-first compiled tool-bypass: TreeWalker DOM pruning to 99% compression (node count ratio), stable locator ranking (id>name>testId>css>role+xpath fallback), deterministic JSON workflow IR (steps: {tool: listTools|invokeTool, selector, args, policy:{risk, semantic_precedence}, verify}), execution via universal-webmcp listTools/invokeTool with policy risk, semantic precedence, shadow-DOM piercing, lazy replanning healing only null selectors (no healing of stale/wrong selectors). Attributes verify_before_store, typed slots. IR compiled offline from training traces, not from test leakage. Correct-family gating still applied for fair comparison; confidence from compilation score + softmax.

B-JOINT-FETCH-WEBMCP-EXPLORATORY (ID B-JOINT-FETCH): Exploratory if mixed still 0/10: Fetch/WebMCP OpenAPI discovery with server routing normalization (HATEOAS link following, OpenAPI spec fetch, path template normalization) attempting triple-channel joint header+body+query+auth composition. Not gating SURVIVES except to test secondary question; reported descriptively.

B-RANDOM-K5-CF (ID B-RANDOM-K5-CF): Uniform random k=5 distinct with correct-family gating. Chance-level.

BINDING-RULE (frozen for all above): correct-family-required rewriting only (candidate eligible iff candidate_families intersect observed_families; single adoption per family alphabetically sorted, cross-family forbidden), softmax temp 0.15 + deterministic jitter seeded, gated UNKNOWN<0.80, verify+freshness gates. State and component representation - genuine non-oracle with correct-family gating and heterogeneous observation: derived_context for synthetic = ONLY url/method/url_path/url_query/url_segments/headers_observed/body_observed; for live = same plus ax_tree_snapshot (CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree truncated 2k tokens, viewport 1280x720) and viewport metadata, all via same parsing path. MUST NOT contain alias_family/query_key/target_prefix/routing_prefix/target_style/path_style/header_key/body_field/auth_scope/expected_template/expected_endpoint. Hierarchical parses template strings, webapi parses endpoint specs (method+path+header+body+auth_scope), compiled parses DOM via TreeWalker to PRUNE 99% then ranks locators. Action/endpoint/IR representation and pipeline isolation with ablated binding: mechanism action_template is string template with ${slot} in URL/path/query/header/body/auth_scope (mixed tasks header+body+query simultaneously). Endpoint spec is tuple (method, path_template, header_template, body_template, auth_scope). Compiled IR is deterministic JSON workflow (steps with tool, selector, args, policy {risk, semantic_precedence}, verify). All pipelines use frozen correct-family-required rewriting (candidate_families = slot types via regex parsing; observed_families = derived_context observed key types; eligible iff intersection non-empty; single adoption per family alphabetically, cross-family forbidden) before _bind+verify. Confidence = softmax over candidate/IR scores temp 0.15 + deterministic jitter gated UNKNOWN<0.80 for ECE. Harness exposes hierarchical_retrieve, webapi_mine, compiled_retrieve, flat_retrieve, bind_correct_family for audit; compiled_execute via listTools/invokeTool with policy.
